name: pai-sho-rules
install: curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh | bash -s -- --channel 8.0 --install-dir $HOME/.dotnet && export DOTNET_ROOT=$HOME/.dotnet && export PATH=$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH && dotnet --info && dotnet restore tests/PaiSho.Rules.Tests/PaiSho.Rules.Tests.csproj

terminals.name: rules-tests
terminals.command: export PATH=$HOME/.dotnet:$PATH && dotnet test tests/PaiSho.Rules.Tests --verbosity minimal
terminals.description: Runs pure Domain rules tests (no Unity editor required)
